name: bb-plugin-sql
description: SQLTools-style Postgres panel for bb: browse schemas/tables, schema-aware SQL completion (0.6), controlled write/DDL (0.5). Agents: sql_query + sql_list_connections.

bb.name: SQL
bb.description: Postgres in bb: browse schemas, schema-aware completion, controlled write/DDL (Agent write / Allow DDL off by default).

scripts.test:completion: rm -rf /tmp/bb-sql-completion-test && mkdir -p /tmp/bb-sql-completion-test && tsc --strict --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --outDir /tmp/bb-sql-completion-test --rootDir . lib/sql-completion/complete.ts lib/sql-completion/context.ts lib/sql-completion/rank.ts lib/sql-completion/keywords.ts lib/sql-completion/types.ts lib/sql-completion/index.ts lib/sql-completion/complete.test.ts lib/sql-statements.ts && node --test /tmp/bb-sql-completion-test/lib/sql-completion/complete.test.js
